values.title: Tours that don't feel like tours.
values.sub: We're the operator. We hire the guides, design the routes, run the logistics. No middleman.

items.d: Long enough to fall in love. Short enough to keep the rest of your day.
Our guides live in the neighborhoods they show you. They have favorite tacos.
Yes, we'll see the icons. We'll also show you the side streets nobody photographs.
Birthdays, bachelorettes, brand offsites. We tailor the route to the room.

editorial.title: We started this because the tours we kept seeing felt like assembly lines.
editorial.p1: Buses with thirty strangers. Headsets. A flag. A guide reciting Wikipedia. We wanted something closer to how we'd actually show a friend the city — by bike where it makes sense, on foot when it doesn't, in a van when distance demands.
editorial.p2: Every route is paced for a real conversation. Every stop earned its place. And every booking goes directly to a person on our team — no algorithm dispatch.

items.d: CDMX (MEX/NLU) to your hotel, in a clean car with a guide who'll point things out on the way.
Open itinerary. We'll go where the day takes you — markets, museums, mezcalerías.
Birthdays, retreats, brand activations. Tell us the brief, we'll build the day.

items.quote: The bike route through Roma and Condesa was the single best thing we did in the city. Our guide Mariana made it feel like we were riding with a friend who'd lived here forever.
items.name: Hana K.

items.q: How fit do I need to be for the e-bike tour?
items.a: If you can stand on a bike and squeeze a brake, you're qualified. The motor does the climbing. We move at conversational pace and stop often.
Free cancellation up to 24 hours before. After that we charge a small fee to cover the guide's day. Weather cancellations are always free.
Yes. The tours that include food (Girly Tour, custom routes) work around vegetarian, vegan, gluten-free, and most allergies. Tell us when you book.

items.q: Do you pick us up at the hotel?
items.a: On day trips and airport transfers, yes. On bike and walking tours we meet at a starting point that makes the route work — usually a café you'll be glad to know about.
All our guides speak English and Spanish. French, Italian, German and Portuguese available with notice.
